Reserve 500g whole chickpeas for garnish, then drain the rest. | Make the Garlic-Lemon Base: In a commercial food processor, blend the fresh lemon juice, garlic, and salt until completely pureed. Blend until it thickens into a paste, then slowly stream in 500ml of ice-cold water while blending. Continue until the mixture turns beautifully pale, smooth, and fluffy. | Process the Chickpeas: Add the hot, drained chickpeas and cumin into the food processor. Taste and add extra salt or lemon if needed. | Plate and Garnish: Spread the hummus into shallow catering inserts, forming a well in the center.
